central_conjecture.name: Leading-Digit Hailstone Conjecture
central_conjecture.statement: Every positive integer eventually enters the distinguished 7-cycle.

current_research_objective: Determine as much rigorous mathematics as possible about the frozen system while continuously attempting to falsify or sharpen universal convergence.
active_attack_lines: cycle exclusion from valuation words, leading-digit words, and exact cycle identities
immediate_stage_1_targets: derive multi-step block compensation inequalities after arbitrary weak runs
combine q>=971 with valuation-word and decimal-sector consistency
formalise leading-digit interval/bounds and accelerated definitions in Lean
continue prior-art equivalence search without novelty claims

new_elementary_facts: For odd x>19, accelerated r=1 steps strictly increase and r>=2 steps strictly decrease.
A large cycle minimum leaves with r=1 and is entered with r>=2.
After s consecutive r=1 steps, one-step return to the pre-run height requires 2^(r+s)>3^(s+1).
stage_1_progress.bounded_exact_consequence: Using the 5M minimum-element exclusion and an exact integer product-window certificate, any different positive accelerated cycle must have at least 971 odd states.
stage_1_progress.mechanism_targeted_computation: Constructed 32-, 50-, and 100-step v2=1 runs are followed first by valuations 2, 3, and 2 and return below their starting seeds after 51, 128, and 304 accelerated steps; compensation is distributed rather than one-step in these examples.
stage_1_progress.proof_direction_update: Cycle Diophantine constraints strengthened. One-step weak-run compensation weakened as a general strategy; multi-step block compensation is now the higher-value descent target.
stage_1_progress.methodological_prior_art: Classical ordinary-Collatz cycle work already uses close powers-of-2/powers-of-3 approximation methods; no novelty claim is made for this strategy.
